blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The municipal government of Naujan in Oriental Mindoro has temporarily banned the entry of live hogs to protect its swine industry from African Swine Fever (ASF). Mayor Henry Joel Teves signed Municipal Executive Order No. 26-040 on September 29, instituting the measure, which covers live hogs brought in for sale, breeding, slaughter, or any other purpose. ASF checkpoints will be set up at entry points to inspect all vehicles transporting hogs and validate health certificates and other official documents.
